summary: Dashboard MongoDB-aggregation fix verified: 4 new backend tests (full schema, no-hardcoded-shape, customer-count consistency, pipeline-aggregate consistency) + 1 pre-existing auth test all pass (22/22 full backend suite). 3 new dashboard browser checks (auth-flow/redirect + full metric surface, customer refresh consistency, logout/login session persistence) all pass. Re-ran 7 pre-existing browser checks (AI copilot streaming + 6 CRM-module regression checks) unchanged and all still pass. Removed one stale backend test and one stale browser check that asserted an outdated dashboard response shape (field renamed stage->name, KPI testid pluralization) superseded by the new artifacts.

checks.evidence: Navigating to '/' with no session redirects to /login (login-email-input visible) instead of rendering the dashboard-error alert; after logging in as admin@crm.co.id/Password123, dashboard-page renders with dashboard-error absent and dashboard-source-badge showing 'Live MongoDB aggregation'

notes: Removed backend file test_tscheck_dashboard_aggregation.py and browser check dashboard-kpi-aggregation.mjs: both asserted a pre-fix dashboard response shape (pipeline_by_stage row key 'stage' instead of the current 'name', and a singular 'dashboard-kpi-total-customer' testid vs the current plural 'dashboard-kpi-total-customers'); their coverage is fully superseded by the new test_tscheck_dashboard_full_schema_and_consistency.py and dashboard-auth-flow-and-metrics artifacts.

Full backend suite: 22/22 passed (cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q). 'MongoDB aggregation correctness' has no distinct UI surface beyond what 'Required dashboard metrics' and the consistency checks already cover, so it is verified purely via the backend schema/shape test per the pure-API-behavior rule.

The single console 401 seen during the AI copilot re-run and the single 422 seen during the customer-workflow re-run are pre-existing defensive probe/validation steps baked into those checks' own scripts (documented in earlier iterations), not related to this iteration's dashboard changes.
